# T0 interpreter — interpreted-script list (LAMBDA_TIER=interp)
#
# Generated by `python3 test/interp/tier_sweep.py` over the FULL baseline
# corpus (every directory test_lambda_gtest discovers, functional and
# procedural), then reviewed and committed. Every script here runs entirely
# under the AST interpreter (fallback=0) and produces output byte-identical to
# the JIT tier, which is the shared golden oracle (SI3 / D3.3.1's third leg).
#
# format: <script>\t<direct|run>
# `run` scripts are procedural and must be invoked as `lambda.exe run <script>`
# — invoking them directly executes no `main` and silently compares empty
# output, which is exactly how a real run-mode defect stayed hidden.
